blocks.text:
**Tour dates:** 5–15 February

## Journey highlights

The route moves through three different settings. The first part centres on Carnival in Rio, the second on Iguazu Falls, and the third leaves several days for a relaxed beach stay.

At Copacabana Palace, you stay in a Deluxe Ocean View room overlooking Copacabana, with breakfast.

On the evening of Day 2, you attend the Carnival Ball at Copacabana Palace, from 22:00 to around 05:00.

The following day includes a 30-minute helicopter flight over Rio and an evening at the Sambadrome. You have a private frisa for six in Sector 4, row A or B.

In Iguazu, you stay in a Junior Suite at Belmond Hotel das Cataratas, inside the national park. The programme includes the Brazilian side of the falls, Macuco Safari by private boat, a 10-minute helicopter flight over the falls, the Bird Park and the Argentine side with the Ecological Train and a walk to the Devil’s Throat.

After Iguazu, the beach part begins. In Alagoas, you stay at Kenoa Exclusive Beach Spa & Resort. The 45 m² Apoena Suite has a terrace with panoramic coastal views, an indoor garden in the bathroom and a Japanese ofuro soaking tub made from aromatic cedar.

## A premium travel experience

The luxury format brings together private transfers, English-speaking guides, a deluxe minivan, a private frisa at the Sambadrome, helicopter flights, a private boat in Iguazu and stays at Belmond and Kenoa hotels.

The Carnival programme extends beyond a single parade night. Before the Sambadrome, you attend the Copacabana Palace Ball, visit Corcovado and the historic centre, and have free time. After the main Carnival night, the morning is again free, followed by an afternoon visit to Sugar Loaf.

Two different fast-track services are available. Airport fast track on Day 1 is optional. It includes an escort from the aircraft door, priority security, help with check-in and baggage, an electric cart and porter service. Fast track at Sugar Loaf on Day 4 is included, providing VIP cable-car access without the general queue.

You can keep Day 5 entirely free or add Lasai restaurant and a trip to Angra dos Reis. These activities are not included in the base price.

In Iguazu, the changing viewpoints are a key part of the visit. The Brazilian side reveals the broad line of cascades; the private boat approaches the falling water from below; the helicopter gives you a view from above; and the Argentine side brings you close to the falls along walkways above the river.

The final days in Alagoas have no scheduled excursions. After Rio’s night-time events and the full Iguazu programme, you have two complete free days by the ocean.

## Rio Carnival in detail

Copacabana Palace is part of the Carnival experience as well as your accommodation. Start the morning with an ocean view from your Deluxe Ocean View room, then spend the evening at the hotel or visit one of the recommended restaurants.

Cipriani is a Michelin-starred restaurant serving contemporary Italian cuisine, with wines paired to the dishes and live piano music. On Day 2, Marius Degustare is also recommended before the Carnival Ball.

The Carnival Ball takes place at Copacabana Palace itself. At 22:00, the grand rooms change character: guests arrive in evening dress and imaginative costumes, music plays and fine food is served. The ball continues until around 05:00.

The Sambadrome offers a different Carnival setting. Samba schools perform here with dancers, floats, costumes and live music. You watch from a private frisa in Sector 4, with six seats in row A or B.

Private transfer to the Sambadrome and an English-speaking guide are included. You choose your return time, so you can leave before the end of the night’s programme.

Between the ball and the Sambadrome, you fly over Rio. The 30-minute route takes in Corcovado, the lagoon, Leblon, Ipanema, Copacabana and Sugar Loaf, bringing the places visited on the ground into one panorama.

On Day 4, Sugar Loaf offers another viewpoint. The first cable-car section takes you to Urca, and the second to the main summit. From there, you can see the coastline, Copacabana, the islands, the Niterói Bridge and Corcovado in the distance.

## Four views of Iguazu

Belmond Hotel das Cataratas is inside the national park, allowing guests to visit the falls at quieter times before the park opens or after it closes to the general public.

On the Brazilian side, you follow a panoramic trail. The falls come into view gradually, until the entire line of cascades forms one broad scene.

After the walk, an open jeep takes you about 3 km through the forest to Macuco Safari. You then board a private motorboat that approaches the falling water.

The helicopter provides the next perspective. The flight over Iguazu lasts around 10 minutes. From the air, the separate cascades form a wide arc in the forest.

The Bird Park completes your day on the Brazilian side. Its walk-through aviaries feature macaws, toucans, hummingbirds and butterflies.

The next day, the Argentine side brings you closer. The Ecological Train takes you to the start of the walk, followed by walkways above the broad river. Three routes let you see the falls from different sides.

The main viewpoint is the Devil’s Throat. Near the platform, the calm river suddenly drops away, spray cools the air and the roar of water drowns out conversation.

## A beach finale in Alagoas

After Iguazu, you fly to Maceió via Rio de Janeiro.

A private transfer takes you from the airport to Kenoa Exclusive Beach Spa & Resort.

The resort has a secluded atmosphere beside a nature reserve and the Atlantic Ocean.

The Apoena Suite covers 45 m². It has a terrace with panoramic coastal views, an indoor garden in the bathroom and an ofuro soaking tub made from aromatic cedar.

Days 9 and 10 are completely free. Spend the morning and evening on the beach, return to your suite during the hottest hours and set your own pace.

The beach has fine pale sand, warm water and a gently sloping entry into the sea. The beach near Kenoa is surrounded by tropical vegetation and does not receive large groups of excursion visitors.

## Accommodation

In Rio, you spend five nights at Belmond Copacabana Palace.

Room category: Deluxe Ocean View.

In Iguazu, you spend two nights at Belmond Hotel das Cataratas.

Room category: Junior Suite.

In Alagoas, you spend three nights at Kenoa Exclusive Beach Spa & Resort.

Room category: Apoena Suite, 45 m², with a terrace, coastal views, an indoor garden in the bathroom and an ofuro soaking tub.

All hotels on a breakfast basis.
